found.title: {{name}} has invited you to their Everstead plan.
found.roleLine: They'd like you to be their <bold>{{role}}</bold>.
found.body: Everstead is a secure platform for organising digital life, accounts, documents, instructions, and final wishes. As <bold>{{role}}</bold>, you'll have access to the sections {{name}} has chosen to share with your role.
found.bullet1: You only see what's been shared with your specific role
found.bullet2: You don't need to do anything now, only when needed
found.bullet3: You can update your contact details after accepting
found.wrongAccount: <bold>Heads up:</bold> This invite is for <bold>{{invited}}</bold>. You're signed in as <bold>{{current}}</bold>. Sign out first if you want to accept with a different account.

accepted.title: You're confirmed.
accepted.bodyNamed: You're now part of {{name}}'s Everstead plan as <bold>{{role}}</bold>.
accepted.bodyGeneric: You're now part of the Everstead plan as <bold>{{role}}</bold>.

declined.title: Invitation declined.
declined.body: We've notified the plan owner. If this was a mistake, ask them to re-send the invitation.

expired.title: Invitation expired.
expired.body: This invite link is no longer valid. Ask the plan owner to re-send your invitation.

error.title: Something went wrong.
error.fallback: Please try again or contact support.

errors.noToken: No invite token found in the link.
errors.wrongEmail: This invitation was sent to {{invited}}. You're logged in as {{current}}. Please sign in with the correct account.
